E-Ticaret Sitesi Kurulum &amp; Yönetimi: E-Commerce Website Setup & Management | Mustafa Anıl Aşlakcı
E-ticaret sitesini yalnızca vitrin değil: I treat an e-commerce website as a working sales channel, not simply a storefront.
Başarılı bir e-ticaret sitesi güzel görü: A successful e-commerce website needs to be fast, clear, trustworthy and measurable as well as visually appealing. I work on store setup, content management, theme development, user experience and conversion improvements on platforms including T-Soft, WordPress, WooCommerce and İkas.
E-ticaret sitesi kurulurken kategori yap: An e-commerce launch should plan category structure, product data, payments, shipping, customer accounts, campaigns, measurement and integrations together. Building a homepage and uploading products alone is not enough to establish a sustainable sales channel.
Mevcut sitelerde ise içerik güncellemele: For existing websites, I work on content updates, category organization, product cards, promotional sections, cart flows and mobile layouts. I focus on manageable solutions that fit the brand’s operational capacity and the platform’s constraints.
T-Soft ve diğer altyapılarda geliştirme: Development on T-Soft and Other Platforms
T-Soft tarafında Twig, HTML, SCSS, CSS v: On T-Soft, I use Twig, HTML, SCSS, CSS and JavaScript to develop category, product, cart, pop-up, landing page and campaign components. My approach is to add features while preserving the existing template structure and reviewing both desktop and mobile layouts.
WordPress ve WooCommerce tarafında içeri: On WordPress and WooCommerce, I address content, themes, products and plugins; on İkas, I work on store setup and content management according to business needs. Using built-in capabilities properly and avoiding unnecessary plugins and code is essential.
Kullanıcı bir ürünün fiyatını, teslimat: Customers should quickly understand a product’s price, delivery conditions, payment benefits and key features. Small ambiguities in product cards, detail pages, filters, search, cart and checkout can reduce conversion.
Bu nedenle tasarım kararlarını yalnızca: I evaluate design decisions through user behavior and business goals as well as aesthetics. Mobile usability, readability, touch targets, page speed, clear campaign messages and trust signals are considered together.
Teknik temel doğru kurulmadan içerik üre: Content alone may not deliver results without a sound technical foundation. I check page titles, meta descriptions, canonical links, sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, mobile compatibility and internal linking.
Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Goog: Correct connections between Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Google Ads and Merchant Center are essential for tracking campaign and product performance. My focus is on usable data for business decisions, beyond simply installing tracking code.
Yeni bir e-ticaret sitesi kurmak, mevcut: I offer project-based support for launching e-commerce websites, reorganizing existing platforms, building campaign pages, improving mobile user experience and developing custom HTML/JavaScript components.
Teknik geliştirme ile e-ticaret operasyo: Because I consider technical development and e-commerce operations together, I also account for how changes will be managed in the admin interface and how they will affect daily workflows.
ERP ve satış kanalları arasındaki veri a: I make data flows between ERP systems and sales channels clear and reliable.
E-ticaret operasyonunun görünmeyen ama e: Data flow between systems is an often unseen yet critical layer of e-commerce operations. ERP systems, websites, marketplaces, shipping providers and integration platforms use the same information in different ways. I analyze processes, organize mappings and expose failure points so product, inventory, pricing and order data moves accurately between them.
Bir ürünün ERP’deki kodu, e-ticaret site: When a product’s ERP code, website SKU, marketplace barcode and integration record do not match, processes can quickly break down. Stock may display incorrectly, prices may fail to update, orders may reach the wrong warehouse or products may never go live. Such issues often stem from a deeper data-model problem than the error visible in the panel.
Bu nedenle entegrasyonu yalnızca bağlant: I treat integration as a traceable process from source to destination, rather than simply enabling a connection. The authoritative source for each field, update frequency and error-checking procedures need to be clear.
ERP tarafında Nebim V3, Tiger, Logo ve D: I have worked with Nebim V3, Tiger, Logo and DIA on the ERP side, and Entegra, Sopyo, Newento and Entegrapi for integration. I consider the data structures of T-Soft, WordPress and İkas alongside Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Amazon and other sales channels.
XML, REST API, JSON, Excel ve CSV gibi f: I can interpret XML, REST API, JSON, Excel and CSV data in the context of business processes. This technical understanding supports clearer communication between operations teams and software or integration providers.
Ürün kodu ve barkod eşleşmemesi, varyant: Common issues include mismatched product codes and barcodes, incorrectly linked variants, inventory from multiple warehouses combined into a single pool, updates overwriting promotional prices, delayed cancellation or return status in the ERP, and incomplete order lines.
Sorunu çözmeden önce kaynağını ayırmak g: Before addressing an issue, I establish its source: ERP data, an integration rule, channel acceptance criteria or a scheduled update. This sequence supports an evidence-based solution rather than trial-and-error changes.
Öncelikle mevcut veri akışını şemalaştır: I first map the current data flow: where products are created, which fields go to each system, which warehouses supply inventory, when orders reach the ERP and which team owns each data set. I then prepare checklists and sample records for critical fields.
Gerekli durumlarda Excel karşılaştırmala: Where needed, I develop Excel comparisons, API tests or small Python validation tools to identify inconsistencies automatically instead of reviewing thousands of records manually. The aim is to make existing systems more reliable without adding unnecessary complexity.
Yeni ERP geçişi, entegrasyon firması değ: I provide analysis and implementation support for ERP migrations, changes of integration provider, new marketplace connections, warehouse restructuring and recurring data-flow errors.
Teknik ekip, e-ticaret ekibi ve operasyo: A shared language between technical, e-commerce and operations teams is essential. I translate business needs into technical requirements and technical output into practical operational checks, helping processes remain sustainable after implementation.
E-ticaret operasyonunu anlayarak, gerçek: I build practical automation based on real e-commerce operations.
Yazılıma yönelmemin nedeni yazılım geliş: I began developing software to solve repetitive, error-prone e-commerce tasks more effectively. I first analyze order, inventory, shipping, invoicing, reporting and cross-functional workflows from an operational perspective, then automate suitable steps with desktop or web tools.
Neden bir e-ticaret uzmanı olarak yazılı: Why I Develop Software as an E-Commerce Specialist
Hazır sistemler genel ihtiyaçları karşıl: Off-the-shelf systems address general needs, but each company has its own product structure, warehouse setup, reporting practices and validation rules. Teams often lose time moving Excel files between systems, checking the same information repeatedly or reviewing hundreds of rows manually.
Operasyonu doğrudan bildiğim için yazılı: My direct operational experience means I start with the real business need. Before writing code, I clarify which file the user receives, which column they inspect, how they identify errors and what they do with the result. This helps avoid unnecessary features and produces usable tools.
Kritik stok değişimlerinin izlenmesi, de: Examples include monitoring critical inventory changes, calculating inter-warehouse transfer needs, tracking marketplace order cancellations, comparing shipping invoices with agreed rates, checking product barcodes and volumetric weight, preparing recurring reports and tracking status across departments.
Her süreç otomatikleştirilmek zorunda de: Not every process needs automation. A simple checklist may be better for infrequent tasks, frequently changing rules or decisions that require human judgment. I use automation where it improves time, accuracy and traceability.
Python, PyQt5 ve Pandas ile Excel veya A: I build desktop tools that process Excel or API data using Python, PyQt5 and Pandas; local-network web tools using Flask, SQLite, HTML, CSS and JavaScript; additional validation layers for existing web panels using Tampermonkey; and notification systems that monitor REST API, XML and JSON data.
Çözümler yükleme ekranı, filtreler, rol: Solutions can include upload screens, filters, role-based actions, exports, desktop notifications, audit histories and basic reports. I keep the technical setup as simple as the team’s computers and permissions allow.
Önce mevcut işlem adımlarını ve istisnal: I first document the existing steps and exceptions: where data comes from, what the user checks, when they act and where the result is saved. Rules are then verified against sample files and real scenarios.
İlk sürüm temel ihtiyacı çözecek şekilde: The first version addresses the core need and is tested with users. Exceptions discovered in real use are added in a controlled way. This creates a solution that delivers value early and grows with the need, rather than a large project taking months to deliver.
Doğru otomasyon yalnızca zaman kazandırm: Good automation does more than save time. It standardizes checks, reduces reliance on individual knowledge, makes past actions traceable and can warn before errors occur. Teams can focus on exceptions and decisions rather than routine checking.
Tekrarlayan bir e-ticaret operasyonunuz,: If you have a repetitive e-commerce task, a manually checked Excel process or a workflow that gets lost between systems, I can analyze the need and develop a project-based solution.

Reklam &amp; Kampanya Yönetimi | Mustafa: Advertising & Campaign Management | Mustafa Anıl Aşlakcı
Reklam ve kampanyaları yalnızca görünürl: I manage advertising and campaigns with a focus on business performance.
E-ticarette reklam bütçesi tek başına bü: Advertising spend alone does not create e-commerce growth. The right product needs to reach the right audience with appropriate pricing and content. I assess Google Ads, Meta Ads and marketplace advertising alongside product profitability, stock levels, campaign calendars and channel performance.
Bir kampanyanın başarısını yalnızca tıkl: Judging a campaign solely by clicks or revenue can be misleading. Commission, product cost, discounts, shipping, ad spend and returns must be considered together. I treat advertising reports as part of the commercial result, connected to e-commerce operations.
Kampanya planında hedef, ürün grubu, büt: Objectives, product groups, budgets, channels, timing and measurement are defined at the outset. Brand awareness, customer acquisition, category growth and stock clearance each require a different approach.
Google Ads tarafında arama, alışveriş ve: For Google Ads, I focus on alignment between search, shopping and remarketing campaigns, product feeds, landing pages and conversion tracking. Accurate Google Merchant Center data is particularly important for shopping campaigns.
Meta Ads tarafında hedef kitle, kreatif,: For Meta Ads, I assess audiences, creative, product messaging and conversion flows together. For Trendyol and other marketplace advertising, I also consider product ratings, pricing, delivery advantages, campaign participation and organic rankings.
İndirim oranı yüksek görünen her kampany: A large advertised discount does not guarantee profitability. Commission offers, coupons, cart discounts and advertising support should be compared on net earnings. I use product-level checks that make price floors, target margins and campaign costs visible.
Stok seviyesi de kampanya kararının parç: Stock levels also inform campaign decisions. Aggressive advertising for products with limited stock or long replenishment times can create operational problems after the sale. Advertising plans need to align with stock, supply and order-processing capacity.
Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads: I review Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, marketplace ad dashboards, and sales reports together. I assess return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rate, cost per click, average order value, new customer share, and product contribution against the campaign objective.
Raporun amacı yalnızca geçmişi göstermek: Reports should support the next decision as well as describe the past. I focus on clear answers about which campaigns to scale, which products to pause, which creative to refresh and where to allocate budget.
Reklam hesabının mevcut durum analizi, k: I offer project-based support for advertising account reviews, campaign restructuring, seasonal campaign plans, product-group performance analysis and regular reporting.
Reklamı tek başına bir medya satın alma: The most productive work is with brands that want advertising improved alongside their e-commerce platform and operations, rather than treated as media buying alone.
Veri Analizi &amp; Raporlama | Mustafa A: Data Analysis & Reporting | Mustafa Anıl Aşlakcı
Dağınık e-ticaret verisini anlaşılır, ka: I turn scattered e-commerce data into clear, comparable information that supports decisions.
E-ticaret ekipleri çok sayıda rapor üret: E-commerce teams produce many reports, but more reports do not necessarily lead to better decisions. I clean marketplace, ERP, advertising and website data, combine it into a consistent structure and turn it into the indicators operations actually need.
Sipariş, satış, iade, iptal, stok, fiyat: Orders, sales, returns, cancellations, inventory, pricing, commission, advertising, products and categories form the basis of my analysis. I combine Excel, CSV, XML, JSON and API data from T-Soft, Entegra, marketplace dashboards, ERP systems and advertising platforms according to the business need.
Her kaynağın kolon adı, tarih biçimi, ür: Column names, date formats, product codes and status definitions can differ by source. The most important part of analysis is often matching and aligning the data correctly rather than drawing charts.
Binlerce satırlık ham satış dosyasından: Common needs include analyzing thousands of sales rows by month, channel, category or SKU; separating cancellations and returns; comparing campaign performance before and after; identifying inventory risks; and finding inconsistent records across systems.
Manuel hazırlanan raporlar hem zaman alı: Preparing reports manually takes time and often repeats the same steps each week. I use Python and Excel tools to make reports built with formulas, pivot tables, and copy-and-paste steps more reliable and reusable.
Excel ve OpenPyXL günlük operasyon rapor: I use Excel and OpenPyXL for daily operational reports, and Python, Pandas and, where needed, PyQt5 for data processing and desktop analysis applications. I also have experience with SPSS, STATA and EViews for academic and statistical analysis.
Raporun kullanıcıya uygun olması teknik: A report’s suitability for its users matters as much as technical accuracy. I present results as filterable tables, summary indicators, appropriate charts or ready-to-use Excel files. I can build tools that let users upload a file and obtain results without writing code.
İyi bir rapor “ne oldu?” sorusunun yanın: A useful report helps answer what happened, why it happened, and what to do next. I interpret metrics in their operational and business context, highlighting issues such as declining margins despite revenue growth, rising cancellations despite higher sales, or products that fail to justify their ad spend.
Raporlama sıklığı ve detay seviyesi de i: Reporting frequency and detail also depend on the need. A short management summary serves a different purpose from a row-level validation file for an operations team.
Mevcut raporların sadeleştirilmesi, fark: I provide support for simplifying existing reports, combining data sources, automating recurring Excel tasks and developing custom desktop analysis tools.
Hedef, gösterişli ama kullanılmayan bir: The aim is a reporting system that the team uses regularly, reduces errors and shortens decision time, rather than an impressive dashboard that goes unused.
